data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Multi-Agent Memory Lifecycle & Context-Rot Prevention — End-to-End ADK & Vertex AI Memory Bank Pipeline, Prefix-Preserving Compaction, and Poisoning Defenses
data.description: End-to-end OKF specification for the 6-Stage Multi-Agent Memory Lifecycle across Google ADK 2.0, Vertex AI Memory Bank, and AKV Serving: defending against all 7 empirical degradation modes (Context Poisoning, Distraction, Confusion, Clash, Collapse, Brevity Bias, and Grep Tax) via Two-Stage Scoped Retrieval, Prefix-Preserving Compaction, Socratic Pre-Commit Firewalls, and GDPR Art. 17 Selective Unlearning.
